CREATE TABLE "public"."job_decisions" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "decidedAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid DEFAULT (gen_random_uuid()) NOT NULL,
  "jobId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "matchSnapshot" jsonb,
  "note" text,
  "reason" text,
  "status" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "userId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "job_decisions_applied_bare_3dd0d51a" CHECK (status = 'dismissed' OR (reason IS NULL AND note IS NULL AND "matchSnapshot" IS NULL)),
  CONSTRAINT "job_decisions_note_length_73ec5843" CHECK (note IS NULL OR char_length(note) <= 500),
  CONSTRAINT "job_decisions_reason_f322f92c" CHECK (reason IS NULL OR reason IN ('role','seniority','location','stack','salary','contract','languages','work_authorization','company','other')),
  CONSTRAINT "job_decisions_status_87345d2c" CHECK (status IN ('applied','dismissed'))
)
